audio.ja: Obsidianでノートを読むとき、いちいちサイドバーをクリックしていませんか？
audio.en: Still clicking the sidebar every time you finish reading a note in Obsidian?

plugin_interaction.mechanism: Default scrolling without Page Flow (hits note footer boundary)

visual.action: Scroll down long note, hit boundary at footer, mouse cursor wanders toward left sidebar file explorer

audio.ja: Page Flowなら、スペースキーを叩くだけ。ノートの末尾に到達すると、流れるように次のファイルへ滑空します。
audio.en: With Page Flow, just hit Space. Once you reach the bottom, glide effortlessly into the next file.

plugin_interaction.mechanism: Hybrid scroll: 85% viewport scroll + seamless file navigation across note boundary

visual.action: Hit Space for smooth scroll, hit Space at footer to glide seamlessly into next note in explorer order, rapid consecutive presses across 2-3 notes
visual.hud_overlay: Space key badge popup, smooth camera zoom

audio.ja: 戻りたい時は Shift とスペース。いつでも矢印キーでピタッと急ブレーキ。
audio.en: Need to go back? Press Shift + Space. And hit the arrow keys anytime for instant braking.

plugin_interaction.mechanism: Reverse hybrid navigation + Reversal brake physics in scroller.ts

visual.action: Hit Shift+Space to reverse glide to previous note, then while cruising forward, hit Up arrow to trigger instant Reversal Brake halt
visual.hud_overlay: Shift+Space badge, Up Arrow Brake badge, micro camera vibration

audio.ja: キーボードだけで思考を止めない読書体験を。Page Flow、Obsidian コミュニティプラグインで今すぐ。
audio.en: Never break your train of thought. Page Flow — available now on Obsidian Community Plugins.

plugin_interaction.mechanism: Obsidian community plugin installation & Portal showcase

visual.action: Show Community Plugins install & enable screen, fade to portal banner, logo and keybindings card
visual.hud_overlay: Install CTA highlight, Logo, Slogan subtitle
